title: Chainlink `latestAnswer()` Used Without Staleness or Round-Completeness Checks
impact:
`latestAnswer()` is deprecated and returns only `(answer)` with no `updatedAt`, `answeredInRound`, or `roundId`. A Chainlink feed that stops updating (e.g., during an L2 sequencer outage, a feed deprecation, or an oracle downtime) will continue returning the last positive price indefinitely. Aave will price assets at stale values, enabling:
  - Borrowing against collateral at pre-crash prices after a market collapse.
  - Liquidations at pre-pump prices after a market pump.
  This is the exact class of bug that has caused real-world losses in protocols using `latestAnswer()`.
